name: Lance
description: Stats and answers for any soccer match you watch on YouTube, computed on your device.

name: Rebeccat
description: Hide personal info on every tab in one click, with nothing you see ever leaving your device.

name: Mr. Anonymous
description: A browser extension for Chrome, Firefox and Safari that blurs faces in images, screenshots and videos on your device.

name: Visionario
description: Browse the web without a mouse: your head moves the pointer and a wink, a smile or a raised eyebrow clicks, with the camera staying on your device.

name: White Cat Against Idle Time
description: A browser extension that turns your pointer into a cartoon cat that keeps moving on its own, so pages that time your idle minutes still see activity.
